name: zclass_assign_damage_handler_recursive_if_missing
description: zClass_Node::AssignDamageHandlerRecursiveIfMissing assigns a damage handler to a node subtree only where nodes do not already have one.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this recursive helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass/OptCatalog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b25f0 validates early return when node->damageHandler is already set, recursive listB traversal from index zero upward, and assigning the handler after children are processed.

The native smoke verifies SetDamageHitCallback and SetDamageTimerCallback propagate one handler through a root-child-grandchild subtree, and ClearDamageHandlerRecursive later removes that same handler.
